g.text: The first 16 harmonics of Do (C4, 261.63 Hz)
Linear frequency axis: one harmonic every 261.63 Hz. The bars show positions only.
Keyboard, a logarithmic scale: 1, 2, 4 and 8 harmonics in each octave
Blue: the harmonic is within 14 cents of this key.
Amber: the harmonic falls between two keys, 31 to 49 cents from the nearest one.
